MEGA MEDICAL CAMP 
 
Name of Activity : MEGA MEDICAL CAMP 
 
Need of the Activity : To NSS volunteers and students and faculties’ free health check up and 
medicines distribution. 
NSS Unit in association with VEENA Diagnostic centre, Tirupati a private hospital in Tirupati is  
conducted Mega Medical Camp in SV COLLEGES. Principle of SV Colleges Dr. N. Sudhakar Reddy  
had invited as guest to the camp and he started by lightning the lamp . Above 200 students and college  
faculties get the checkup and hospital management distributed free medicines to all. Dr. P. Mouli had  
supported in making the camp successful. 
Few photographs of the programme are attached herewith for kind perusal.

WORLD ENVIRONMENT DAY 
 
Name of Activity : WORLD ENVIRONMENT DAY 
 
Need of the Activity : To provide awareness on Environment and its protection. 
 
NSS Unit in association with Institution’s innovation council, in SV College of Engineering is  
conducted World’s Environment day -2023 on 05.06.2023. The programme was initiated by Principal  
Dr.N Sudhakar Reddy and addressing the volunteers regarding the plantaion and maintain the 
premises with plants. He also adviced to water the plan ts daily those are near to our homes. Dr. T.  
Chandraiah NSS PO of Sri Venkateshwara College of Engineering had taken the session and 
explained about the event and given the awareness on Environment. At last principal and NSS PO’s  
started plantation near the college. 
Few photographs of the programme are attached herewith for kind perusal.

AWARENESS PROGRAM ON ANTI RAGGING 
 
Name of Activity : Anti-Ragging 
 
Need of the Activity : To educate the students in terms of ragging and its consequences 
 
 
The NSS Unit of S V College of Engineering has conducted the awareness programme on Anti-Ragging 
by Mrs. Anju Yadav, C.I, Renigunta, to the all students’ community. Madam inspires a lot regarding  
healthy life style without involving any ragging activities in education life. And also explaining the  
consequences of ragging in all aspects with so many real life examples during her service.

NSS DAY 
Name of Activity : NSS DAY CELEBRATION-BOOKS DISTRIBUTION 
 
Need of the Activity : Celebrating NSS day with students in nearby villages. 
 
NSS unit celebrated 54 th anniversary in nearby adopted village Venkatapuram. NSS volunteers  
visited the Anganvadi schools and celebrated NSS day by cutting cake and Dr. T. Chandraiah NSS PO  
of SV Colleges had distributed note books for children. After cake cutting volunteers dist ributed cake 
and chocolate to the students. Dr. N. Sudhakar Reddy had started the buses and donated the books for  
students

BLOOD DONATION CAMP 
 
Name of Activity : BLOOD DONATION CAMP 
 
Need of the Activity : To motivate NSS volunteers and students towards donating the blood to 
save lives. 
NSS Unit in association with We Are with You Charitable Trust conducted a blood donation camp 
in SV Colleges. Dr. N. Sudhakar Reddy had started the camp by lightning the lamp. RUIA, Hospital  
management collected the blood by checking the donor’s health and details. Totally 210 units of blood  
had collected. Refreshments were distributed to all the donors. It was the highest count of blood  
collected compare to previous camps. NSS volunteers and WAY foundation together make the event  
grand success. 
Few photographs of the programme are attached herewith for kind perusal.
